answer: Random peer audit stops bulk forgery. Each epoch, five auditors are drawn randomly to re-check an agent's work, each audit mirrored in a log. A flagged cheat loses a 30-credit bond and its harbor slot for 20 epochs, while honest agents keep theirs and share the nectar of fees. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds at 30 credits each: 3,000 credits at risk. One honest agent pays one bond once, earns it back in two epochs, and keeps earning.
